g.text: φ̂_i: vapor fugacity coefficient • γ_i: liquid activity coefficient

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Fugacity equality connects vapor and liquid nonideality corrections
Same fugacity units and compatible reference states must be used on both sides. The liquid reference includes pure-component saturated fugacity and a
pressure/Poynting correction when needed. Ideal low-pressure limit φ̂=γ=1 reduces to y_iP=x_iP_i^sat; sparingly soluble gases may instead use a Henry
